params.melody: the shared melodic contour, played on synthesized voices, not sampled from either record

caption.age7: Same tune, two different outfits. Switch between them.
caption.age13: The notes do not change. What changes is speed, the sharpness of the sound, and what the drums are doing. That is most of what made the second record feel new.
caption.adult: Deliberately synthesized rather than sampled. Isolating the melodic contour from its two treatments demonstrates the interpolation question better than either recording would.
